name: Telegram (talk to Stella from your phone)
why: Lets a Telegram bot become a door into Stella.
needs_human: Only you can create a bot in your own Telegram account.
status_note: Your token is stored safely now. The Telegram bridge itself arrives in a later update.

steps.title: Open BotFather in Telegram
steps.you_see: Telegram opens a chat with BotFather, the official account for making bots. It has a blue check mark.
steps.do: Press Start. (Or search for @BotFather inside Telegram and choose the one with the blue check.)

steps.title: Ask for a new bot
steps.you_see: A text box to type messages.

steps.title: Choose a display name
steps.you_see: BotFather asks what to call your bot.
steps.do: Type any name people will see, for example: My Stella. You can change it later.

steps.title: Choose a username
steps.do: It must end in the letters bot and be unique across Telegram, for example: my_stella_1234_bot. It cannot be changed later.

steps.title: Copy the token
steps.you_see: A message with a token: a number, a colon, then a random-looking string.
steps.do: Touch and hold the token, then copy it. Do not send it to anyone.

format_hint: it looks like 1234567890:AAH... : a number, a colon, then letters and numbers
after: Keep the token private: anyone who has it can control your bot.
if_leaked: If it ever leaks, open BotFather, send /revoke, pick your bot, then run /connect telegram again with the new token. The old one stops working at once.
